asked.item: Did I put the skills in the wrong place (~/.claude/skills)?
Do the skills only work for coders / work in Cowork?
How to get content-coach working in Cowork

verdict.reason: The pages say Cowork does not read ~/.claude/skills, that skills work in Cowork, and that Cowork needs a ZIP upload through the Claude account.

steps.text: Yes, that folder is the wrong place for Cowork, because Cowork does not read the computer's ~/.claude/skills folder.
For Claude Cowork, use personal skill ZIP uploads through your Claude account.
The skills are not only for coders, since you install each skill once and can use it in Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Claude Cowork.
Package 1 skill folder as a ZIP containing its SKILL.md and support files, then open Customize > Skills, select +, then + Create skill, and select Upload a skill.
Upload that skill's ZIP and enable it, then start a conversation using the same Claude account, and don't upload the entire 8-skill pack as 1 skill.
